plugins.microphonePermission: COOPR listens while you hold Ask, or while hands-free is on. On this iPhone the words are recognized on the device. A typed question is used when speech recognition is unavailable.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: COOPR turns your question into text on this iPhone. The audio is not kept.

plugins.microphonePermission: COOPR listens while you hold Ask COOPR. The recording goes to the server to be transcribed and is not kept.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: COOPR uses your location to measure ground distance to a green you have verified. That distance is not saved as a shot.

plugins.photosPermission: COOPR reads a photo you choose so a server can extract golf numbers. The photo is not kept on the server. You review every number before it is saved.
plugins.cameraPermission: COOPR uses the camera for a photo of a screen, scorecard, or club. The photo is not kept on the server. You review every number before it is saved.
